dataset: Donchian M15 XAUUSD trades: one bot, the live settings
settings: 10-bar channel breakout on M15, only with the H4 EMA30 trend (price at least 0.5% away), stop 2 x ATR14 (= 2 x m15_atr14_usd) with an 8 USD minimum, take profit 3R, risk 0.2% per trade, 2h pause after 3 losses, 7-day time stop
costs: spread 0.30 USD/oz, commission 7 USD/lot, FundedNext swap (bars part only)
leakage: every column before `outcome` is known when the order is sent; outcome, win and R are the result
missing: no empty cells: prev_trade_R and hours_since_prev_exit of trade 1 (no previous trade) were filled with the column mode

columns.name: trade_id
columns.description: sequence number, time order

columns.name: hour_utc
columns.description: hour of the decision, UTC

columns.name: weekday
columns.description: day of week of the decision

columns.name: session
columns.description: UTC session: 0 = Asia 00-06, 1 = London 07-11, 2 = London-NY overlap 12-15, 3 = New York 16-20, 4 = late 21-23

columns.name: is_long
columns.description: trade direction: 1 = long (buy), 0 = short (sell)

columns.name: entry_price
columns.description: planned entry = close of the signal bar

columns.name: m15_atr14_usd
columns.description: ATR(14) of M15 bars at the signal bar

columns.name: m15_atr_vs_5d_avg
columns.description: M15 ATR divided by its average over the previous 5 days (above 1 = more volatile than usual)

columns.name: d1_atr14_usd
columns.description: daily ATR(14), previous completed day

columns.name: d1_adx14
columns.description: daily ADX(14), previous completed day: trend strength, not direction

columns.name: d1_trend_with_trade

columns.name: day1_change_pct

columns.name: signal_bar_range_atr

columns.name: signal_bar_close_position

columns.name: move_1h_atr
columns.description: price move over the previous hour, positive = in the trade direction

columns.name: move_4h_atr
columns.description: price move over the previous 4 hours, positive = in the trade direction

columns.name: move_24h_atr
columns.description: price move over the previous 24 hours, positive = in the trade direction

columns.name: signal_bar_volume_vs_20
columns.description: tick volume of the signal bar / average of the 20 bars before it (above 1 = busier breakout)

columns.name: volume_4h_vs_5d

columns.name: spread_vs_5d

columns.name: eurusd_4h_pct
columns.description: EURUSD change over the last 4 hours (positive = dollar weaker)

columns.name: eurusd_24h_pct
columns.description: EURUSD change over the last 24 hours (positive = dollar weaker)

columns.name: eurusd_5d_pct
columns.description: EURUSD change over the last 5 trading days (positive = dollar weaker)

columns.name: usdjpy_24h_pct
columns.description: USDJPY change over the last 24 hours (positive = dollar stronger)

columns.name: silver_24h_pct
columns.description: XAGUSD change over the last 24 hours

columns.name: silver_minus_gold_24h_pct
columns.description: silver 24h change minus gold 24h change (positive = silver stronger than gold)

columns.name: spx500_24h_pct
columns.description: S&P 500 change over the last 24 hours (history from 2022-10; earlier trades filled with the mode)

columns.name: spx500_5d_pct
columns.description: S&P 500 change over the last 5 trading days

columns.name: prior_loss_streak
columns.description: consecutive losing trades immediately before this one

columns.name: prev_trade_R
columns.description: result of the previous trade (empty for the first trade)

columns.name: prev_trade_same_side
columns.description: 1 = the previous trade had the same direction

columns.name: hours_since_prev_exit
columns.description: time since the previous trade closed (empty for the first trade)

columns.name: is_tick_sim
columns.description: how the trade was simulated: 1 = real ticks (from 2026-03-23), 0 = M15 OHLC bars (2022-07 to 2026-03)

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: RESULT, not known before entry: 1 = take profit hit, -1 = stop loss hit, 0 = closed by the 7-day time stop

columns.name: win
columns.description: RESULT, not known before entry: 1 = profitable after costs

columns.name: R
columns.description: RESULT, not known before entry: profit in units of risk after costs (1R = 0.2% of the account); a full win is about +3.9R

removed_rule: see feature_selection.py: removed = no permutation-test link (p >= 0.05) with win or R AND not a stable direction in >= 3 of 4 time blocks with |AUC - 0.5| >= 0.03, or a duplicate of a stronger column; all columns are still in donchian_dataset_full.parquet
